description: This file contains unit tests for the AssistantTextParser, verifying its ability to correctly parse and handle segments of assistant responses with specific tags and behaviors.

classes.name: AssistantTextParserTests
classes.description: Test suite for the AssistantTextParser functionality.

methods.description: Verifies handling of plain text without any tags.

methods.description: Checks behavior when tags contain no content.
